osv_source_json_contract.validation: Actual Linux binary, isolated requirements fixture and synthetic local OSV database; no project dependencies installed.
osv_source_json_contract.findings: Exit 1 retains package identity, advisory groups, affected-package records and CVSS vectors.
osv_source_json_contract.no_findings: Exit 0 defaults to an empty results array; --all-packages retains package identities but omits their vulnerabilities field.
osv_source_json_contract.network_limit: Online scan exited 127 because api.osv.dev/deps.dev could not resolve from the validation host; offline output-shape checks do not establish live service availability.

artifact_verifier_contract.cosign_result: Real supplied-root verification succeeded; wrong signer, issuer and expected digest were rejected.
artifact_verifier_contract.root_trust_boundary: Pinned official repository plus targets.json hash checked out of band; not an independent cryptographic TUF bootstrap.
artifact_verifier_contract.slsa_result: Published v0.2 and upstream v1 statement layouts checked; live positive provenance verification blocked by public TUF DNS. Mocked parser cases are not a live trust-verification result.

remote_and_governance_contract.public_archive_result: Actual unauthenticated GitHub commit lookup and codeload extraction succeeded; missing scanner remained unknown/INCOMPLETE rather than a clean scan.
remote_and_governance_contract.governance_result: Actual read-only exact-branch rules and stable-release/activity acquisition worked; HTTP403 legacy protection and unavailable bypass details remained partial/unscored. No settings changed.
remote_and_governance_contract.image_command: OSV 2.7.1 scan image flag syntax checked against the installed official binary; Docker-backed image execution was not run.
